scope: Complete-candidate P0–P2 static implementation review of candidate/source, candidate/src/rev2, candidate/legacy host/dependencies/acceptance, C# launcher source, bound protocols, and targeted native/D0 evidence. Checked all 129 candidate/protocol manifest members without hash mismatches.

findings.title: D0 bridge prerequisites trust qualification statuses instead of reconstructing raw evidence
findings.trigger: A selected D0 qualification retains D0_BRIDGE_SMOKE_PASS while its underlying control, OS-exit, pending-completion, or independent journal-failure evidence is missing or changed.
findings.effect: check() still returns ALL_INTEGRATION_GATES_RECONSTRUCTED. Neither this function nor freeze_cpu8.py reruns the selected D0 raw audits and qualification checks, allowing stale summaries to satisfy mandatory prerequisites.
findings.recommendation: Authenticate each selected raw input manifest, rerun raw_audit.audit and cpu8_audit.qualify in D0 mode, and reconcile their results with the stored qualification. Preserve the explicitly permitted freeze_binding exclusion.

findings.title: CPU8 verification accepts missing outer monitoring evidence
findings.trigger: SAMPLES.jsonl is empty or lacks SAMPLE records, or WATCHDOG_SAMPLES.jsonl is absent.
findings.effect: The progress-validation loop can perform zero checks, and WATCHDOG_SAMPLES.jsonl is never read. The verifier can reach CPU8_INTEGRATION_PASS without reconstructing outer sampling coverage, five-second gaps, or applicable resource limits.
findings.recommendation: Require nonempty supervisor and watchdog sample streams and reconstruct their start, inter-sample, read-duration, and terminal gaps, resource limits, and progress linkage using the CPU8 schemas.

findings.title: Successful tool receipts are not linked to the observed watchdog invocation
findings.trigger: The supplied tool records describe another successful command or session whose command text contains the freeze digest and whose working directory matches the root.
findings.effect: Both terminal branches can set tool_exit_verified=true without matching the request to WATCHDOG_START.command, the selected run, or the watchdog closure output. An unrelated successful tool invocation can satisfy the terminal-binding requirement.
findings.recommendation: Bind the prospective request and actual terminal response to the recorded watchdog command, root, run, and freeze argument, and reconcile the terminal closure output.

findings.title: D0 accounting ignores attempts absent from the reservation list
findings.trigger: An observed D0 attempt exists under an unregistered run, including a bridge failure before CASE_BEGIN.
findings.effect: actual_d0() iterates only supplied registrations. Its bridge-observer scan also counts only matching registered run names, so retained unregistered attempts contribute nothing and the twenty-attempt check can pass incorrectly.
findings.recommendation: Inventory raw D0 starts independently, reconcile every applicable start to exactly one prospective reservation, and reject unregistered attempts before calculating totals.

limitations: Read-only review completed without executing project code, tests, scripts, or native libraries; no delegation was used. The DLL was hashed only.
Supplied native evidence was inspected selectively and not reproduced. Findings describe statically established validation bypasses, not claims that the supplied successful D0 smokes failed.

Historical approval remains historical. Final data-only bindings, execution freeze, formal eight-case execution, and restoration have not been certified by this review; documented outer OS lifecycle gaps remain UNKNOWN.
